Spellbinder (film) | Spellbinder is a 1988 American thriller film directed by Janet Greek, starring Timothy Daly and Kelly Preston.  The screenplay was written by Tracy Tormé.  The original music score was written by Basil Poledouris.  The film was marketed with the tagline "A nightmare of illusion and betrayal".
Daddy and Them | Daddy and Them is a 2001 American film written, directed by, and starring Billy Bob Thornton.  In addition to Thornton, it stars Laura Dern, Andy Griffith, Ben Affleck, Kelly Preston, Diane Ladd, Brenda Blethyn, Tuesday Knight, Jamie Lee Curtis and Jim Varney.  This was Jim Varney's last live-action film; he died a year before the movie's release.  It was also his penultimate movie.
